segments.name: Online consumer finance
segments.description: Facilitates consumer loans for borrowers in mainland China and matches them with institutional funding partners, earning service, guarantee and financing income.
segments.evidence: The Group operates and manages its business as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers and institutional funding partners pay service fees for loan facilitation and post-origination work, with guarantee and financing income from the Group's own lending.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group charges a service fee to the borrower indirectly through financial institutional cooperators or to certain institutional funding partners directly.
